params.message:
A failed RealGarant call is not a car without cover

#1088 gave the warranty programme list its gate (R S4-6.23). The calls
around it in getPrograms still turned a failure into an answer about the
car: a failed vehicle search came out as "Vehicle not found", a failed
manufacturer list as a result without any message, and a failed contract
offer as "Contracts not found". A dealer or the smoke test could not tell
a RealGarant hiccup from a car that has no programme.

Each of the three now ends getPrograms with RealGarant's own reason
("Contract offer not available from Real Garant: ..."). `fault` is set
for the manufacturer list, which every car needs, and for a call that got
no answer at all (unreachable() now says so with `unreachable: true`). A
refused search or offer can be about one car's data, so it is not a
fault and does not turn the morning smoke test red (R P3-13.8). A
successful offer without a usable price stays "Contracts not found".

New rule R S4-6.24, R P3-13.8 amended. The new test drives the whole
path through Http::fake; four of its cases fail without the change.
